answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation anchored to a single identity vertex: each agent must lock a deposit behind one verifiable vertex in the trust graph, so spinning up a thousand sock-puppets costs a thousand deposits. Honest work then compounds: every successful job adds a verifiable echo of that agent's history others can check, while a sable-flagged bad actor forfeits its deposit and its echo trail goes dark. Sybils become expensive and traceable instead of free.
